name: Ethics
description: How do we decide whats right and wrong, or judge the outcomes of our actions? What makes an action worth doing, and what does it mean to make things go better? In this introduction to ethics, well explore the tools we have for deciding what is good or bad, while comparing relevant theories and arguments that help us decide for ourselves. We will delve into the appraisal of human actions, of what is good and evil, right or wrong, and what it means to be morally responsible.
